why: The double arc turns a quarter turn clockwise each time: open to the right, open down, open to the left, open up. One more quarter turn brings it back to the first position, open to the right, which is option 4. Option 1 is the position of figure 2.
trick: A shape that turns 90 degrees each step returns to its start after 4 steps.
